walkthrough:
Identify the general term in the binomial expansion of $(1 - px)^5$:
$$T_{r+1} = \binom{5}{r}(1)^{5-r}(-px)^r$$

Set $r = 3$ to find the term in $x^3$:
$$\text{Term in } x^3 = \binom{5}{3}(-px)^3 = 10(-p^3 x^3) = -10p^3 x^3$$

Equate the coefficient to $-2160$ and solve for the constant $p$:
$$-10p^3 = -2160 \implies p^3 = 216 \implies p = \sqrt[3]{216} = 6$$
